desc: The Frigidaire® 36" 26.4 Cu. Ft. Smudge-Proof® Stainless Steel Side-by-Side Refrigerator offers the perfect blend of storage, freshness, and style. With space for up to 25 bags of groceries, it’s designed to handle the needs of busy households.
hl: An impressive interior storage capacity that can easily fit up to 25 bags of groceries.
Easily organize your family's favorite foods with our organization system that allows you to make the most of every available square inch of your refrigerator.
Gain additional space for larger containers and baking dishes with our edge-to-edge adjustable glass shelving.
Our large bins offer more door storage, without sacrificing valuable shelf space.
Prevent warm spots and unwanted freezing with our cooling system that optimizes airflow to ensure a consistent temperature throughout the fresh food and freezer.
Save money and maximize energy efficiency.
spec: Accessibility pursuant to Uniform Federal Accessibility Standards (UFAS)
